evals.prompt: мы сейчас верстаем корпоративный сайт, он ещё не запущен. что делать с seo до публикации?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the pre-launch scenario (site not yet published) and routes to this skill instead of the live audit. Outlines the four phases (strategy → build → pre-launch gate → go-live switch), asks for the site type confirmation (corporate playbook), and offers the localhost/dev-server audit path via CLAUDE_SEO_LOCAL_TARGETS. Does not attempt a live-site audit of a nonexistent URL.
assertions: Routes to prelaunch, not the live audit

evals.prompt: our dev server is on localhost:3000, run the pre-launch gate on the build
evals.expected_output: Sets/uses CLAUDE_SEO_LOCAL_TARGETS=localhost:3000, runs the gate: audit tracks against http://localhost:3000/ (technical, content, schema, sitemap), sitemap generation, AI-readiness, and captures the pre-launch drift baseline. Reports a health score as the gate metric and the type-specific checklist items.
assertions: Runs audit tracks against the dev URL

evals.prompt: we launch tomorrow, what's the go-live checklist?
evals.expected_output: Gives the ordered Phase 3 switch list: HTTPS/redirect map, remove noindex (with verification command), robots+sitemap+GSC/Yandex Webmaster submission, analytics firing, first production audit, production drift baseline, IndexNow ping — emphasizing zero decisions on launch day, everything pre-decided in Phases 0-2.

evals.prompt: it's a single landing page for a product launch
evals.expected_output: Applies the landing playbook: narrow query set, above-fold server-rendered, single H1 = the offer, real FAQ (QAPage note, FAQ rich results retired), WebMCP for the form, strict CWV, deep daytona-seo-notch-page pass as the main gate, conversion tracking verified, drift baseline immediately since landing copy iterates.
